structural_change: HBM-HCBANK10 10-21 cbrw5m: structural successor of hbm_hcq_bank_cb_rw2 (clk boundary 420.9 ps TT, 349 of 355 sinks). rw4 row-local write assembly (WROW 2: hold / asm / bad per SRAM row on clk_d<r>, clk_a eliminated); stage-control long-reach registers copied per row (STG 1: read enable/address on the row capture root, lane-enable sources + leaf go on clk_e<r>; clk_c = cv/cd chain only); kept beat copies anchored at the xb_v / xb_beat pins so the in-face root clk is pin flops at one face only; rw5m: row read capture + read control folded into clk_d<r> (no clk_w / clk_x). 0 added edges.
